remarks: Stunning 3BR/2BA remodeled ranch style condo in West Norwalk's highly sought-after Ledgebrook community. This end-unit offers privacy, space, and style with a remodeled kitchen featuring custom cabinetry, SS appliances, and under-cabinet lighting. Refinished hardwood floors, crown molding, and custom closets throughout. Large utility closet with full-size washer/dryer and extra storage.  Oversized primary suite includes multiple closets and en-suite bath with double-sink granite vanity and soaking tub. Two additional bedrooms provide flexible space for guests, office, or hobbies. Second full bath features a spa-style shower panel.  Enjoy a cozy double-sided brick fireplace between dining and living areas, plus access to a private, covered deck via sliding glass doors. Recent updates include 2024 Lennox electric heat pump/air handler with 10-year parts & compressor warranty, and Bluetooth thermostat for remote climate control.  Attached 1-car garage fits 2 cars tandem with overhead storage. Quiet location at the end of Ledgebrook Dr near Gillies Ln, yet minutes to SoNo train, shopping, beaches, and golf. Community amenities: pool, hot tub, sauna, clubhouse, gym, library, and social events. A must-see home in a peaceful, resort-style setting!
